item.title: Iran says Strait of Hormuz will reopen if U.S. leaves region
item.description: Iran said Friday the Strait of Hormuz will reopen if the U.S. leaves the Middle East, adding: "If it does not leave, we will expel it."

item.title: American journalist injured in West Bank clashes
item.description: Among the injured was Heidi Levine, a veteran American photojournalist working with the Washington Post.

item.title: What to know about new guidelines for menopause and perimenopause treatment
item.description: New health guidelines strongly support the use of hormone therapy to treat perimenopause and menopause symptoms. Menopause specialist Dr. Kameelah Phillips joins to discuss.

item.title: Vance calls selling access to the White House "disgusting" and slams Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan
item.description: Vice President JD Vance weighed in on questions about access to the White House in exchange for money during a CBS News town hall in Michigan. He also rallied voters against Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed. CBS News' Taurean Small and Aaron Navarro report.

item.title: Friend of woman allegedly killed by ex-cop testifies at murder trial
item.description: Sandra Birchmore's close friend testified in court that she asked police in Canton, Massachusetts, to investigate then-police officer Matthew Farwell after the pregnant 23-year-old's mysterious death. Tom Hanson has more.

item.title: Vance says he'll "follow the law" if subpoenaed by Democrats
item.description: "CBS Evening News" anchor Tony Dokoupil sat down with Vice President JD Vance for a CBS News "Things That Matter" town hall airing Saturday. Discussing Kimberly Guilfoyle, Vance said anyone "selling access to the White House" should "suffer consequences."

item.title: Powerful Santa Ana winds fueling wildfires in Southern California
item.description: Firefighters are battling new wildfires in Southern California fueled by powerful wind gusts. Rob Marciano has more.

item.title: Michigan Senate campaigns heat up as Trump and Vance lash out at El-Sayed
item.description: The close Michigan Senate race between Republican Mike Rogers and Democrat Dr. Abdul El-Sayed is heating up. Ed O'Keefe reports.

item.title: Oregon mom says she "started running over to the school" when she heard of deadly shooting
item.description: A teen gunman killed three children and a teacher at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon, before he was killed by a bystander, police say. Kayla and Tyler Major are the parents of a child who was in school at the time of the shooting but was not injured. They share their experiences.

item.title: 3 children, 1 teacher killed in Oregon school shooting, police say
item.description: Three children and a teacher were killed, and two others critically wounded, in a shooting at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon. The suspect was shot and killed by a bystander.

item.title: With Tesla Roadster debut, Elon Musk shows "flying cars are real"
item.description: Elon Musk unveils Tesla's new Roadster, which uses high-pressure air thrusters to leave the road entirely during a livestreamed event at his SpaceX facility in Texas.

item.title: Vigil after teen shooter killed 3 children, teacher at Oregon school
item.description: A 16-year-old gunman killed three children and a teacher at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon, before he was killed by a bystander, police say. Jonathan Vigliotti reports.

item.title: Latest news on Oregon elementary school shooting where 3 kids died
item.description: A 16-year-old male opened fire at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon, officials said, killing 3 children and 1 adult. CBS News' Jarred Hill reports, and criminal law professor and former NYPD detective Kirk Burkhalter joins with more context.

item.title: Eye Opener: Deadly school shooting in Oregon
item.description: A deadly shooting at an elementary school in Oregon, and firefighters battle a new wave of wildfires in California. All that and all that matters in today's Eye Opener.

item.title: Body found in barrel at Lake Mead identified as Arkansas man
item.description: The discovery of the barrel by boaters in May 2022 sparked memories of the city's mob era, which lasted from the 1940s to the mid-1980s.

item.title: Strait of Hormuz still unsafe for ships, maritime group warns
item.description: Vessels in the Strait of Hormuz still face "indiscriminate attacks" even if they switch off tracking systems, a maritime risk firm warns.

item.title: Alleged Chinese agent has ties to scam group, records show
item.description: A California realtor charged with working as a Chinese agent and her partner have links to individuals involved in sprawling criminal enterprises, according to federal court filings.

item.title: Musk donates over $150 million to Senate GOP group, assisting Paxton
item.description: Billionaire Elon Musk is offering a nine-figure assist to Texas GOP Senate candidate Ken Paxton, a decisive return to large-scale political giving for the world's richest man.

item.title: Oregon police give details on elementary school shooting
item.description: The Bend, Oregon, police chief and other officials gave an update on the elementary school shooting that killed at least three children and one teacher. The suspect was shot and killed by a bystander. CBS News' Camilo Montoya-Galvez reports and school safety expert Kieran Carroll has more.

item.title: Vance says "selling access to the White House" is "disgusting"
item.description: Vice President JD Vance told CBS News in a "Things That Matter" town hall in Michigan that anybody who is "selling access to the White House" should "suffer consequences."

item.title: Massachusetts residents compete to be new voice of Boston Logan Airport: "Wicked glad you're here"
item.description: A Massachusetts competition is underway to become the new voice of Boston Logan International Airport, and the auditions are bringing out classic New England sounds. Tony Dokoupil has the wicked story.

item.title: Pennsylvania man who killed 8 people was "controlling" patriarch, police say
item.description: The Pennsylvania man accused of killing eight people "exercised significant control" over his family at their Erie home, police said.

item.title: 10/15: CBS Evening News
item.description: At least 4 killed in school shooting: sources; Vance addresses corruption in town hall.

item.title: Bones found in Philadelphia's "house of horrors," sources say
item.description: Bones were discovered outside the so-called "house of horrors" in Philadelphia, but it's unclear whether they are related to the ongoing investigation into Raymond "R.C." Horsch, a suspected serial killer.

item.title: White House's Katie Zacharia confirms she never passed bar exam
item.description: The White House described Katie Zacharia as "uniquely qualified" to be the new press secretary.

item.title: As Jolly runs for Florida gov., he confronts prior ties to alleged fraudster
item.description: Shortly after David Jolly launched his campaign for Florida governor, his former boss was indicted for taking over $100 million from a disability nonprofit. Jolly says he wasn't aware of the scheme.

item.title: Trump calls off plan to livestream Fort Hood shooter's execution
item.description: "He will die, as scheduled, by firing squad, but this event will not be streamed," President Trump wrote on Truth Social.

item.title: Amazon launches new AI devices that can listen and take notes
item.description: The products include a silicone wristband that can be clipped to clothing and a device that magnetically attaches to the back of a phone.

item.title: Chats from Nolan Wells' phone show what friends said when he vanished
item.description: Messages pulled from Nolan Wells​' phone show what his friends said before and after the 18-year-old disappeared in early July following a boat outing with friends.

item.title: AI leaders lobby Trump health officials in government-run chat room
item.description: A Slack workspace has served as a war room for AI industry insiders and Trump administration officials to launch a rapid campaign aimed at persuading Americans to manage their healthcare and medical records on apps.
